text:
emily: Holding the release window 1. Platform reports artifact fetch 410/Gone from objectstore - deploy-bot aborting promote.
raj: Can you paste the fetch logs?
emily: logs:
```
[deploy-bot] GET https://objstore.company/releases/v2026.03.21/app.tar.gz -> 410 Gone
[deploy-bot] head-object -> 404 (version tombstoned)
[deploy-bot] verify failed: object missing expected version metadata -> abort
```
deploy-bot: promote blocked: missing-artifact-version (attempts=4). Auto-promote suspended.
nina: Looks like the object was tombstoned by the lifecycle job when the uploader used the wrong prefix. Ops: any recent lifecycle config changes?
platform-bot: config-ops: lifecycle policy for bucket releases moved to shorter ttl yesterday (30d -> 1d) for cleanup. Policy change author: @chris.
chris: I landed a cleanup policy for old nightly artifacts, but it shouldn't have matched release keys. I'll check the rule set right now.
raj: In parallel, can we pin traffic to the currently-running digest (sha256:beef1234) and suspend the canary? We don't want an incomplete release sitting open.
emily: Yes, pin to last-good digest and set deploy-bot suspend. Also need a short customer note: "Release delayed: objectstore lifecycle tombstone removed staging artifact; rolling back to previous image while we restore artifact; ETA ~30m."
chris: Found the bug - the lifecycle glob was too greedy and matched `releases/v*`. I disabled the rule and started an object-restore request for the tombstoned key. Request id: restore-8833.
platform-bot: object-restore queued (restore-8833). Estimated completion 12m. Also queued CDN key purge for `releases/v2026.03.21/*` after restore.
raj: Good. Are we okay to keep the window pinned? Any DB migration concerns?
nina: No migrations in this release. Pin is low risk. Recommend cache invalidation once object is restored.
emily: Doing actions: /deploybot suspend R-2026-03-21-4 (done) and routing pinned to sha256:beef1234. Drafting comms.
chris: Restore finished, object present, sha256 matches expected (cafe5678). I've pushed a fresh object version with correct metadata and prevented lifecycle rule re-enabling.
platform-bot: CDN purge completed for keys releases/v2026.03.21/* -> edges invalidated.
deploy-bot: manual promote allowed by emily. Pre-promote smoke job queued.
raj: Smoke and quick integration on restored artifact starting now.
chris: Follow-up: file opened to tighten lifecycle rules and add a preflight CI check that validates object existence + metadata before promote. (ticket PLAT-1299)
nina: Smoke green, integration passed. Approve manual promote.
deploy-bot: manual promote accepted. Rolling update: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m waits.
emily: Removing hold and posting release note to #release-announcements: "Short hold due to objectstore lifecycle tombstone accidentally matching release keys; pinned previous digest while we restored artifact; manual promote completed after verification; rollout resumed."
chris: Added follow-ups: lifecycle rule rollback and preflight artifact check in CI. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
